note: Both sets extract many valid claims but suffer from heavy duplication. Set A has a few errors where it misses the decimal point in scientific notation (e.g., 793E10 instead of 7.93E10). Set B has a hallucinated unit (kg/m^5) and repeatedly binds 'Tower' as the entity for soil and steel material properties, which is poor entity-attribute binding. Set A is slightly better due to fewer binding errors.
